package service

import (
	"database/sql"

	"github.com/go-redis/redis/v8"
	"github.com/segmentio/kafka-go"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for service_struct_has_excessive_dependency_count: Services with too many unrelated dependencies, which often signals a god-service.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type MegaService struct {
	db         *gorm.DB
	legacyDB   *sql.DB
	cache      *redis.Client
	queue      *kafka.Writer
	emailer    EmailClient
	smsClient  SMSClient
	auditLog   AuditLogger
	fileStore  FileStorage
	fraudCheck FraudChecker
}

type EmailClient interface {
	Send(to, subject, body string) error
}

type SMSClient interface {
	SendText(phone, message string) error
}

type AuditLogger interface {
	Log(event string) error
}

type FileStorage interface {
	Upload(path string, data []byte) error
}

type FraudChecker interface {
	Evaluate(accountID string) (bool, error)
}
